description: NaLaS₂ is Caswellsilverite structured and crystallizes in the trigonal R̅3m space group. Na¹⁺ is bonded to six equivalent S²⁻ atoms to form NaS₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent LaS₆ octahedra, edges with six equivalent NaS₆ octahedra, and edges with six equivalent LaS₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 3°. All Na-S bond lengths are 2.99 Å. La³⁺ is bonded to six equivalent S²⁻ atoms to form LaS₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent NaS₆ octahedra, edges with six equivalent NaS₆ octahedra, and edges with six equivalent LaS₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 3°. All La-S bond lengths are 2.90 Å. S²⁻ is bonded to three equivalent Na¹⁺ and three equivalent La³⁺ atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing SNa₃La₃ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted.
